lines.text: You alone are to be feared.
When You are angry, who can stand before You?
and the earth feared and was still
when God rose up to judge,
to save all the lowly of the earth.
Even the wrath of man shall praise You;
with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God;
let all the neighboring lands bring tribute
to Him who is to be feared.
He breaks the spirits of princes;
He is feared by the kings of the earth.

pictures.scene: James Ward, Gordale Scar — the overhanging cliffs standing over the gorge with the herd small beneath them, You alone are to be feared, when You are angry who can stand before You
pictures.name: pd_ward_gordale_scar

pictures.scene: Johannes Tavenraat, Het onweer — the lightning out of the dark cloud and the deer standing still under the bent pine, from heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
pictures.name: pd_tavenraat_het_onweer

pictures.scene: Jozef Israëls, Kinderen der zee — the poor children of the shore wading out together through the shallow water, when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth
pictures.name: pd_israels_kinderen_der_zee

pictures.scene: Nikolai Ge, What Is Truth — the governor in his bright robe putting his question to the bound man standing in the shadow, Selah, even the wrath of man shall praise You
pictures.name: pd_ge_what_is_truth

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Arnolfini Portrait — the two standing with their hands joined and the one hand lifted to make the promise, with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself, make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_arnolfini_portrait

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Family of Darius before Alexander — the royal house of a beaten kingdom down on their knees before the conqueror they had feared, let all the neighboring lands bring tribute, to Him who is to be feared
pictures.name: pd_veronese_darius

pictures.scene: Eduard Schwoiser, Heinrich IV. vor Canossa — the emperor left standing in the penitent's robe at the gate below the throne on the terrace, He breaks the spirits of princes, He is feared by the kings of the earth
pictures.name: pd_schwoiser_heinrich_vor_canossa
